title: clausena harmandiana
intro: Clausena harmandiana, commonly known as the Clausena or Thai bitters, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Clausena harmandiana include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids and coumarins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties.
